results.what: Show-through of Riemann's philosophical theses on 'Geistesmassen' (soul as a growing, interconnected mental mass; indestructibility of formed Geistesmassen; thinking requires a material carrier and has a location). These are not mathematical results.
results.usually_credited_to: Bernhard Riemann. Fragments of this kind appear in the 'Fragmente philosophischen Inhalts' in the Nachlass section of his Gesammelte mathematische Werke (ed. Weber and Dedekind, 1876).

deep.surprise_reason: The verso is blank apart from ink bleeding through from the recto. That recto text is Riemann's known philosophical fragment on Geistesmassen, and it contains no mathematics.
transcription_corrections: The faint writing is not original text on 140v. It is show-through of the recto (140r, the 'previous page'). The ~35 faint lines match 140r line by line, including the long leftward parenthetical line '(die Verschiedenheit des Processes, in welchem sie sich bilden)' and the numbered theses 4)-6). The verso should be recorded as blank (show-through only).
